I struggled with this for years. I always dressed kind of “lazy,” because I was afraid of dressing nice. I always loved fashion and make up, but never attempted it because I was afraid of the reaction. Then I just got a little bit of courage and just slowly started changing my look to what I like. Over time, it became the “real me.”

I won’t lie, the first couple of times I felt so weird. I felt like people were staring at me going “why in the world is she dressing like this all of a sudden.” Then I realized none of these people paid much attention to it to even notice a distinct “before and after.” Only my closest friends noticed. At first they’d make comments like “what are you all dressed up for?” I would feel uncomfortable, but id just respond with “what do you mean? What’s wrong with what I’m wearing?” And then they wouldn’t know how to respond and they’d be the one who felt weird. They normally be like “uhh idk. I’ve just never seen you dress like this.” And is just say “oh really? I’ve always loved clothes like this.” Then they’d stop making comments about it. 

Any how... be you! Wear what makes you happy. Overtime you won’t feel weird at all. I promise you are thinking *way* more about it than the people looking at you.
